verse.text: Yea, I know that I am nothing; as to my strength I am weak; therefore I will not boast of myself, but I will boast of my God, for in his strength I can do all things; yea, behold, many mighty miracles we have wrought in this land, for which we will praise his name forever.

entries.text:
Preparation day! Did laundry, wrote emails to family, and companion study
in Dumaguete.
Morning proselyting and teaching discussions in Sibulan district.

Taught the Plan of Salvation to Brother Bautista and enjoyed fresh buko
juice.

District Council meeting in Dumaguete City. Practiced Cebuano language
roleplays.
Service project helping local families repair bamboo fences.

Street contacting along Rizal Boulevard during sunset overlooking the
ocean.

Sacrament meeting in Dumaguete 1st Ward. Bore testimony of the Savior
Jesus Christ.
